name: Neverends
source:
A [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mediation_(Marxist_theory_and_media_studies)#Remediation]remediation[/url] of Zen Pencils' [url=http://zenpencils.com/comic/131-c-p-cavafy-ithaka/]remediation[/url] of Constantine P. Cavafy's [url=http://www.cavafy.com/poems/content.asp?cat=1&id=74]Ithaka[/url], which is a remediation of Homer's [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odyssey]The Odyssey[/url].

[From [url=http://nsnstudios.tumblr.com/post/96567913503/finally-finished-a-game-its-called-neverends]NSN Studios[/url]]
translation:
这是对Zen Pencils改编的[url=http://zenpencils.com/comic/131-c-p-cavafy-ithaka]Constantine P·Cavafy《伊萨卡》[/url]的再改编，而Cavafy的诗作本身又是对荷马[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odyssey]《奥德赛》[/url]的再改编。

[译自[url=http://nsnstudios.tumblr.com/post/96567913503/finally-finished-a-game-its-called-neverends]NSN Studios[/url]]
